UI_trait_AdrenalineJunkieDesc:
Moves faster when highly panicked.
Improves endurance recovery and slows down fatigue gain, based on the amount of very close zombies.
UI_trait_HemophobicDesc: Panic when performing first aid on self and others, gets stressed when bloody.
UI_trait_InsomniacDesc:
Slow loss of tiredness while sleeping.
Interrupted sleep causes stress.
UI_trait_SWAcrophobic_Desc: Height causes stress, especially when outside.
UI_trait_SWAdaptiveMetabolism_Desc: Adjusts calorie burn rate when near unhealthy weight.
UI_trait_SWBouncer_Desc: Slows down endurance loss during fight.
UI_trait_SWBrittle_Desc: High chance of hand or foot fracture from falling, based on Nimble lvl.
UI_trait_SWColdSensitive_Desc: Being cold increases stress, based on Hypothermia moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWCompanion_Desc: Reduces unhappiness and stress with Frog, Slug or Snail companion in the inventory.
UI_trait_SWCompetitiveEater_Desc: Twice faster food and drink consumption actions.
UI_trait_SWCouchDweller_Desc: Reduces unhappiness and slows down boredom gain when indoors.
UI_trait_SWDrunkard_Desc: Stays drunk for longer and doesn't get fatigue from alcohol, not being drunk adds chance to drop weapon during fight, based on Endurance moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWFlailer_Desc: Chance to trip and scream when running, based on Panic moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWFlatEarther_Desc: Can't use map and minimap. Can read map items.
UI_trait_SWFlimsy_Desc: Wearing heavy bags on the back causes upper arms pain which can drastically slow down the attack speed.
UI_trait_SWHeatSensitive_Desc: Being hot increases stress, based on Hyperthermia moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWImmuneResponse_Desc: Improves endurance recovery when infected with knox, based on Sickness moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWInjured_Desc: Spawns with a various severity fracture in random lower body part.
UI_trait_SWIronLiver_Desc: Stays drunk for less time and doesn't get fatigue from alcohol.
UI_trait_SWLuddite_Desc: Equipping guns causes stress, based on Aiming lvl.
UI_trait_SWLurcher_Desc: Chance to trip when running exhausted, based on Nimble level and Endurance moodle level.
UI_trait_SWManiac_Desc: Reduces unhappiness and stress when bloody.
UI_trait_SWOneTrickPony_Desc: The highest weapon skill is the only weapon type the player can equip. Doesn't affect ranged weapons.
UI_trait_SWPacer_Desc: Slows down endurance loss when running or sprinting.
UI_trait_SWPitCrew_Desc: Twice faster vehicle and refueling actions.
UI_trait_SWProductive_Desc: Twice faster crafting, tailoring and consolidation actions.
UI_trait_SWRavenous_Desc: Hunger causes pain, based on Hunger moodle lvl.
UI_trait_SWScaredycat_Desc: Chance to scream when surrounded, based on the amount of very close zombies.
UI_trait_SWSloth_Desc: Slows down fatigue gain when walking or standing still.
UI_trait_SWSquirrel_Desc: Slows down fatigue gain when running or sprinting.
UI_trait_SWTrekker_Desc: Improves endurance recovery when walking or standing still.
UI_trait_handydesc:
Faster and stronger constructions.
Twice faster building and barricading actions.
UI_trait_nightowldesc:
Requires little sleep. Stays extra alert even when sleeping.
Night time and darkness reduces stress and slows down fatigue gain.
